# M3M, Jacob & Co partner for ₹1,650-crore branded residences project in Gurugram

## Gurugram real estate: The branded residences project, located in Billionaire's Block in Sector 111 along the Dwarka Expressway, will comprise 120 units

Published on: Nov 17, 2026, 13:48:58 IST

By Vandana Ramnani

Gurugram-based M3M India has partnered with New York-based luxury watchmaker Jacob & Co. for their second branded residential development in India, an ultra-luxury project in Sector 111 along the Dwarka Expressway in Gurugram. The development entails an investment of ₹ 1,650 crore and is expected to generate a topline of ₹ 3,300 crore, the company said in a statement on November 17.

M3M India partners with New York-based luxury watchmaker Jacob & Co. for its second branded residential project in India, an ultra-luxury development in Sector 111, along Gurugram's Dwarka Expressway. (Photo for representational purposes only) (Pexels)

Named M3M Jacob & Co. Residences, the project will comprise 120 homes averaging approximately 7,300 sq ft each, with prices starting at ₹ 26 crore. The residences are expected to be launched at an average price of ₹ 40,000 per sq ft.

Located within M3M's Billionaire's Block, the project will be designed by international architecture and design firms Woods Bagot and Belt Collins. It will combine Jacob & Co.'s design philosophy with M3M's expertise in luxury residential development. The developer said the project would feature some of the largest residences along the Dwarka Expressway.

With this launch, M3M's cumulative development investment in Billionaire's Block will reach ₹ 2,750 crore, reinforcing its positioning as a destination dedicated to globally branded residences, the company said.

Spread across 170 acres along the Dwarka Expressway, Billionaire's Block is envisioned as an enclave exclusively for globally branded residential developments. M3M Jacob & Co. Residences will join the precinct's growing portfolio, with the developer planning to bring more international luxury brands into the development.

The developer also plans to bring five-star hospitality partners into Billionaire's Block. Building on its association with luxury hospitality brand Roseate at the Jacob & Co. development in Noida, the company said the forthcoming towers would combine distinctive branded design with personalised services.

M3M said only a limited number of towers would be developed within the 170-acre enclave, with subsequent phases expected to command a premium over earlier launches.

"For a discerning buyer, and for the ultra-high-net-worth investor thinking in decades rather than quarters, entering at this stage of Billionaire's Block's evolution is a decision that combines lifestyle, legacy and long-term capital appreciation. This is the kind of prudent, patient wealth-building philosophy that billionaire investors around the world understand well; get in before the market fully recognises the scarcity value," said Robin Mangla, president, M3M India.

## Second branded residence collaboration

The latest development marks the second branded-residence collaboration between M3M and Jacob & Co. in India, following their earlier partnership in Noida. Residences in the Noida project have reportedly traded at premiums of ₹ 3–4 crore over their launch prices, the developer said.

The ownership proposition at Billionaire's Block will also extend beyond the physical residence through M3M Black Circle, the company's private, invitation-only platform for homeowners in its branded residential developments.

Recently unveiled in Paris in the presence of Jacob Arabo, founder of Jacob & Co., the platform offers homeowners access to founders and visionaries behind leading global luxury brands, exclusive privileges and curated lifestyle experiences, the company added.

# M3M launches invite-only Black Circle for luxury homeowners, targets ₹13,400 crore

 By The Standard Desk · India · 3 min read Published 30 OCT 2026, 1:39 PM 

 

Buying a branded luxury home from M3M India now comes with a key to a private club. On Thursday, the Gurugram-based developer launched M3M Black Circle. It is an invitation-only platform that lets its homeowners meet the people behind the global luxury brands linked to their homes.

The launch comes with a big growth target. M3M calls itself India’s largest player in branded residences. It plans to grow its branded portfolio from about 6.9 million sq ft to 10 million sq ft by the end of 2026. The company expects this to bring in an additional ₹13,400 crore in revenue. With only two months left in the year, that means adding about 3.1 million sq ft in a short time.

Paris debut with Jacob Arabo, Elie Saab Jr.

Black Circle began in Paris. M3M hosted owners of its Jacob & Co. and ELIE SAAB residences on a curated trip. They met Jacob & Co. founder Jacob Arabo and Elie Saab Jr. in person. The trip also included fine dining and private luxury cruises.

This is not the first such meeting. Earlier, buyers of M3M’s Trump homes met Donald Trump Jr. in the United States at his private invitation. Through Black Circle, the company says it wants to make this kind of access a regular part of owning one of its branded homes.

‘Not a trip, a sense of belonging’

“Luxury today is no longer defined by what you own, but by who you know and where you are welcome,” said Robin Mangla, President, M3M India.

“With Black Circle, we are opening doors that have traditionally stayed closed: to the founders, designers and visionaries behind the world’s most admired brands. What we saw in Paris was not a trip; it was a sense of belonging to a global circle,” he said. Mangla added that this was the new benchmark for branded living in India and the company intends to keep raising it.

Six projects, 500 owners

M3M and Smartworld together have six branded-residence projects:

– Three Trump developments

– Two ELIE SAAB developments

– One Jacob & Co. development

According to company figures, these cover about 6.9 million sq ft. Around 500 owners live in them.

More global brands on the way

M3M says it is in advanced talks with some of the world’s most sought-after luxury brands for new real estate tie-ups in India. As the portfolio grows, the company plans to roll out Black Circle across all of its branded residences.

For homebuyers, the message is clear. Developers in the luxury segment are no longer selling only space, design and amenities. M3M is now pitching exclusive access and curated experiences with global brands as part of the deal. The company says this will create a more personal and lasting ownership experience.

# ₹15 cr for Couture Living: ELIE SAAB enters Delhi NCR's realty mkt with M3M

## From Runway to Real Estate: ELIE SAAB's ₹15-Crore Homes Hit NCR

The company is selling homes in Gurugram at Rs 37,000 per square feet. The starting price is Rs 15 crore.

Sunainaa Chadha New Delhi 

4 min read Last Updated : Jan 14 2026 | 11:30 AM IST

#### Listen to This Article

 Realty developer M3M India is doubling down on branded luxury housing. On Tuesday, the realtor announced a partnership with global fashion and lifestyle brand ELIE SAAB to develop two ultra-luxury residential projects in Delhi-NCR with a combined investment of ₹3,500 crore.

 The collaboration will see 300 high-end apartments in Gurugram and around 650 homes in Noida, catering to India’s fast-growing appetite for globally branded, design-led residences. The Gurugram project will be developed by M3M India, while the Noida development will be executed by group firm Smartworld Developers.

 Speaking in Gurugram, M3M India promoter Pankaj Bansal said the tie-up with ELIE SAAB marks a significant step in the group’s strategy of partnering with international luxury brands to differentiate its residential offerings and drive premium sales. “We have partnered with ELIE SAAB for two branded residential projects in Delhi-NCR,” Bansal said, adding that demand for globally curated luxury homes continues to rise among affluent Indian buyers.

 The Gurugram project, named ‘Signature Residences by ELIE SAAB’, will come up along the Dwarka Expressway and involve an investment of around ₹2,000 crore. Spread across 1.3 million square feet, the project will offer 300 premium homes priced at ₹37,000 per sq ft, with starting prices of around ₹15 crore per unit.

 For buyers, this signals a new wave of internationally branded living spaces aimed squarely at India’s ultra-affluent segment.

 In Noida, M3M’s group firm Smartworld Developers will develop a six-acre project with a total investment of ₹1,500 crore and a developable area of 1.2 million square feet. The project will feature approximately 650 units, including about 200 larger luxury homes priced between ₹9 crore and ₹12.5 crore, and 450 serviced apartments with starting prices of nearly ₹3 crore. Apartments in Noida will be sold at around ₹33,000 per sq ft.

 For ELIE SAAB, the partnership marks its formal entry into India’s branded residences segment. ELIE SAAB Jr, Vice Chairman and CEO of ELIE SAAB Group, said the brand entered real estate in 2019 with its first project in Dubai and has since completed over 25 branded residential projects globally. “We are bullish on the Indian market and are entering it in partnership with the M3M Group to deliver unique properties,” he said.

 Beyond real estate, ELIE SAAB is also planning to strengthen its retail presence in India. ELIE SAAB Jr revealed that the brand intends to open a ready-to-wear store in Delhi, spanning about 3,000–4,000 sq ft, though a timeline for the launch has not yet been finalised.

 The ELIE SAAB tie-up adds to M3M India Group’s growing portfolio of branded developments. The company has already delivered a residential project in Gurugram under the Trump brand and, in October last year, partnered with Jacob & Co, another globally renowned luxury brand, for a project in Noida.

 Two locations, two very different buyer profiles

 The partnership will deliver homes in Gurugram and Noida, each catering to a slightly different kind of luxury buyer.

 Gurugram (Dwarka Expressway):

 M3M India will develop 300 premium apartments under the name Signature Residences by ELIE SAAB.

 Price: ₹37,000 per sq ft

 Starting price: ₹15 crore per home

 Total development: 1.3 million sq ft

 Investment: ₹2,000 crore

 This project is aimed at buyers looking for large, statement homes in one of NCR’s fastest-growing luxury corridors, with direct access to Delhi and the airport.

 Noida (6-acre project):

 Group firm Smartworld Developers will develop around 650 homes with a more layered pricing strategy.

 Luxury residences: ₹9–12.5 crore (200 units)

 Serviced apartments: starting ₹3 crore (450 units)

 Price:~₹33,000 per sq ft

 Investment: ₹1,500 crore

 This mix makes the Noida project attractive both to end-users and investors looking for branded serviced living.

 What does “ELIE SAAB living” actually mean?

 For buyers, branded residences aren’t just about a logo. ELIE SAAB brings:

 Signature interior aesthetics and finishes

 Design consistency across common areas and homes

 A global luxury positioning that few Indian projects offer

 Is this for you?

 These homes are clearly aimed at:

 Ultra-high-net-worth individuals seeking iconic, branded living

 Buyers upgrading from luxury to statement real estate

 Investors betting on brand-led appreciation in NCR’s prime corridors

 As luxury housing in India evolves beyond size and location, global branding is becoming the new differentiator. With ELIE SAAB entering the Indian residential market through M3M, buyers now have access to homes that blend fashion, design and real estate—all under one address.
